entity: BF Borgers' former public-company audit clients, where they went after the 2024 SEC bar
what_we_add: 27 ex-clients at four Nigerian firms; 75 of 218 with no later audit; new-auditor split by firm size (54 one-partner, 72 at 2-5 partners, 17 bigger)
why: Bloomberg Tax: nearly 40% of ~180 Borgers clients had no new auditor by mid-June 2024; ours 75 of 218 (34%), within 25%, same direction. Accounting Today: 125 Borgers clients landed at mostly smaller firms in Q2. No source names the Nigerian firms.
